mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persona_evolution_proposal (id, persona_id, period_start, period_end, signals_digest, proposal_items, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{personaId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{signalsDigest}, #{proposalItems}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, persona_id, period_start, period_end, signals_digest, proposal_items, status, reviewer, remark, created_at FROM persona_evolution_proposal WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, persona_id, period_start, period_end, signals_digest, proposal_items, status, reviewer, remark, created_at FROM persona_evolution_proposal WHERE persona_id = #{personaId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
